title: Checker result, version 1
description: check.json, written by the checker session (docs/PLAN.md section 8, step 5) after reading the work folder and the prepared book's checkpoint file, and read by 'prep verify-check' and 'prep report'. One verdict per prompt and per section, the evidence for each, and an issue list for the drafter. tools/prep/README.md ('check.json') explains every member and what the script verifies.
$comment: Closed schema (additionalProperties: false) so a misspelt member is caught; members starting with 'x_' are allowed and ignored. Patterns end in $(?!\n) for the reason given in checkpoints.schema.json.

prepared_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the prepared EPUB the checker judged. A check is evidence only for exactly that file.

original_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original EPUB (the work folder's source.json source_sha256).

instructions_version.description: The preparation instructions the checker applied; must equal book.instructions_version of the checkpoint file.

round.description: Optional: the round of the preparation loop (1 to 3).

date.description: The day of the check, YYYY-MM-DD.

prompts.description: Exactly one entry per prompt of the checkpoint file.

sections.description: Exactly one entry per section of the checkpoint file.

issues.description: Everything the drafter must fix (status open) or that a previous round raised and is now fixed (status resolved). May be empty.

verdict.description: pass only when every prompt and every section passes and no open blocking issue remains.

paragraphRef.description: A reading-stream paragraph as numbered by 'prep extract' (d02-p006). Footnote bodies (dNN-nNNN) and source XHTML ids are not citable.

evidence.description: Free text: why, with short quotations from the cited paragraphs.

id.description: A prompt id of the checkpoint file.

verdict.description: pass requires every criterion true and at least one citation.

supported_by_section.description: The reference answer is supported by the prompt's own section.

citations.description: The paragraphs of the prompt's own section that support the answer. The script confirms each lies inside that section.

accepts_paraphrase.description: The answer states the essential ideas clearly enough that a reader could accept a correct paraphrase as Correct.

answerable_from_section.description: The prompt can be answered from its section alone.

does_not_give_away_answer.description: The prompt does not give its answer away.

id.description: A section id of the checkpoint file.

natural_boundary.description: The section's break falls at a natural boundary under the instructions.

id.description: Stable across rounds: a later round reuses the id when it reports on the same issue.

severity.description: blocking: the book cannot be delivered until fixed. minor: worth fixing, does not block.

target.description: A prompt, checkpoint or section id of the checkpoint file, or 'book'.

resolution.description: Optional: how a resolved issue was fixed.
